verdict: Round 5 is mixed and slightly worse overall. Both A/B critics prefer A's face. - Wins: stance and head placement. The posture gates now pass 6/6, against 0/6 in round 4. Torso pitch is idle +0.3..+1.3°, walk +3.0..+3.6°. The head is +1.8..+2.6 px forward of the neck base in E on every action. Critics confirm she no longer leans back. The face now follows the head (AD 6->8, anim 6->7). - Regressions: the 3D face texture turns to mush at 96 px: muddy grey eye blobs, brown speckle on the cheeks, and a face of only 1 eye pixel in profile. On-model drops 7->3 and readable at 1x 6-7->3-4. The N head reads as a pointed hood, with the bow slid to mid-head. - Bangs: the critics split. AD calls them full or even heavy. Anim and game see bare forehead and temple wedges. The bangs gate backs anim and game, failing in every S/SE/SW clip with 84-164 skin px above the brow (temple wedges between the fringe and the side locks; E/W/N/NE/NW clean). - Head still looks set back in profile: the gate passes, but the back-hair and bun mass sits behind the spine line. - Unchanged: hurt and dash T-arms, legs splitting in run SE/SW and jump S (limbs 34/48), and shade_swap 0/48.
